manifestations.invariant: After a severity downgrade closes a triage case, the reserve release is calculated from the pre-close severity, and reopen restores that prior reserve exactly once.

contract_bindings.quote:
The actuarial reserve calculator releases the approved delta only when the
pre-close severity is available to the consumer.

A reopened review keeps the prior balance from its recorded history exactly
as the consumer compares the restoration event.
